blocks.text: LIVE: Gilas Pilipinas vs Syria – Fiba Asian Qualifiers 5th window MANILA, Philippines–Gilas Pilipinas got another opportunity to climb up in the Fiba World Cup 2027 Asian Qualifiers after Jordan and Iran suffered blowout defeats to begin the fifth window on Friday in Seremban, Malaysia. Jordan was crushed 103-64 by New Zealand while Iran fell to unbeaten Australia with an 84-67 decision at Karisma Arena. Both teams dropped to identical 5-4 records in Group E. The Philippines is playing Syria as of posting time, needing a victory to create a three-way tie for third with Jordan and Iran in Group E […]...
